subject: Human Body
title: Types of Bones
description: A quick win: understand Types of Bones.

hook.text: Not all bones look alike. Your body has long ones, flat ones, short ones, and oddly shaped ones.

buildup.text: Long bones like the femur act as levers for movement. Flat bones like the sternum protect organs.

discovery.text: Short bones in the wrist and ankle absorb shock. Irregular bones like vertebrae have unique shapes.

twist.text: There's a fifth type: sesamoid bones. They form inside tendons. The kneecap is the most famous one.

climax.text: Each bone type evolved for a specific job. Shape follows function in your skeleton.

punchline.text: Five bone types, 206 bones, one body to run.

quiz.question: What type of bone is the kneecap?
